description: Defines the InfoField class used to reference document info fields within the MigraDoc DocumentObjectModel, including properties, constructors, serialization, and validation logic.

classes.name: InfoField
classes.description: Represents a document info field that can be referenced and serialized within the document.

classes.name: InfoField.InfoFieldValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable values for the InfoField properties, specifically the Name property.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the InfoField instance.

methods.name: set_Name(string value)
methods.description: Sets the Name property after validation.

methods.name: IsValidName(string name)
methods.description: Checks if the provided name is a valid InfoFieldType.

methods.name: IsNull()
methods.description: Indicates whether the InfoField instance is null (not set).

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the InfoField into DDL format.
